name: stent_expansion
description: Nitinol stent deployment reference: superelastic loop closure and radial-force/deployment metrics from the stent-deployment example.

model.vessel: compliant tube law D = 4.6 + 6.0 p (mm at MPa)

metrics.name: loop_closure
metrics.assert: stress at zero strain after a full cycle is 0 (superelastic recovery)

metrics.name: hysteresis
metrics.assert: unloading stress < loading stress at mid strain

metrics.name: monotone_oversizing
metrics.assert: radial force increases with nominal diameter over a fixed lumen

notes: Level-1 fidelity (see rfcs/0004): uniform ring, Winkler vessel, no taper.
Radial-stiffness vs ASTM F2394 published data lands with Level-3 3D contact FEM.
